content.text: No non-solicitation, no-hire, or personnel-restriction language exists anywhere in the agreement. The only restrictive covenants (Section 6, Exclusivity) concern participation in competing Internet projects, not hiring or soliciting employees.

input.quote: 6.3 During the term of this Agreement and for a period of two years after the expiration date of this Agreement, HDI shall not participate in any project similar to the Site on the Internet from which products substantially similar to Deerskin Products (including, without limitation, the products of Wilson's House of Leather, Excelled and and companies similar to Wilson's House of Leather and Excelled) are offered for sale to consumers on the Internet.
input.rationale: The agreement contains no non-solicitation, no-hire, or employee-inducement covenant. Searches for "solicit", "employ", "hire", "induce", "personnel" and a sweep of all "shall not" obligations return only (i) confidentiality duties, (ii) the independent-contractor/no-joint-venture clause referring to "employee" only as a relationship descriptor (p0061), and (iii) the Section 6 exclusivity covenants, which restrict participation in competing Internet projects (p0037 on the Company, p0042 on HDI) rather than the hiring or solicitation of either party's staff. Because no hiring restriction is imposed on us as Customer, the preferred position — no non-solicit on Customer — is already satisfied and no redline is required. Note for the deal team: the exclusivity covenant at p0037 binds us during the term, but that is a competition restriction reviewed under a separate rule, not within the scope of NOSOLICIT.
